g.title: J_EPS_JET
g.text: EPS J18: VBAT_JET behind SW1 and the eFuse U19

g.title: W5A
g.text: 2 x 22 AWG per pole: 0.93 A over two wires at the 12 W guard, 22 AWG derated 2 A (SQSO-HAR-001 5.2): 23 %

g.title: J_JET_PWR
g.text: carrier J1: DC input 11.2-16.4 V; TVS2200, LC filter, LM61440 5 V buck

g.title: J_OBC_JET
g.text: OBC J3 (4 to 6 pos, change E10): PA9 TX via U28, PA10 RX via U29, JET_3V3 to PG6 (10 k), NTC to an OBC ADC input

g.title: W5B
g.text: 115200 baud, OBC transmits 8N2 (DS-11105-001 2.10.4), SMART-QSO-ICD-002 framing; signals twisted with ground; PT_NTC/PT_RTN a twisted pair. Signal currents under 5 mA

g.title: J_JET_UART
g.text: carrier J2: U11 B to module UART1 RXD (pin 205), U10 B from UART1 TXD (pin 203), 3V3_IO via 100 Ohm, NTC pass-through
